課程綱要.課程目標: 本課程目的在培養台灣新一代的公司法學以及企業組織法學人材. 藉由系統性的學習, 讓學生們有效掌握各種企業組織(如獨資商號, 各種合夥及各類型公司等)的開始, 發展及解散之全部過程. 並著重在各種企業組織於21世紀現代社會產業經濟中關鍵作用的研究討論.
課程綱要.授課內容: 包括(但不限於)以下單元 1. 代理理論 2. 合夥 3. 公司基礎/架構 4. 股份有限公司的結構 5. 董事注意義務 6. 董事忠實義務 7. 股東資訊權 8. 股東代位訴訟 等等現代公司法學的重要議題.
課程綱要.教科書/參考書: Business Organizations: Cases and Materials,James D. Cox, Melvin Aron Eisenberg, Twelfth Edition, Foundation Press, 2019.

課程綱要.課程目標: Students are expected to gain a concrete understanding of the way industrial organizations operate and apply economic models to analyze competition, market power, regulation, and social welfare.
課程綱要.授課內容: A basic understanding of calculus and probability theory is expected.
課程綱要.教科書/參考書: Our lectures closely follow Paul Belleflamme and Martin Peitz (2015), Industrial Organization – Markets and Strategies, 2nd Edition, Cambridge, UK: Cambridge University Press (denoted “BP“). Please obtain a copyright version of this textbook, and supplementary learning materials, such as journal articles, will be disseminated in class. You may also consult the following textbook to better your understanding of industrial economics. On the more theoretical side, Jean Tirole (1988)‘s The Theory of Industrial Organization, 1st Edition, published by the MIT Press would be a very good reference for model-builders. On the more intuitive side, Lynne Pepall, Dan Richards, George Norman (2014)‘s Industrial Organization: Contemporary Theory and Empirical Applications, 5th Edition, published by John Wiley ＆ Sons, Inc. would help you put the economic models in context. Other good references which I also recommend are Dennis W. Carlton and Jeffrey M. Perloff (2005)‘s Modern Industrial Organization, Global Edition, 4th Edition, published by Pearson PLC, for you to derive insights from simplified models that I present in class. You may also read Luis M. B. Cabral (2000)‘s Introduction to Industrial Organization, 2nd Edition, published by The MIT Press for you to frame your ideas from different perspectives.
課程綱要.評量配分比重: 30％ Problem Sets, 20％ Mid-term Exam, 20％ Final Exam, 30％ Term Project

課程綱要.開課單位: 產業經濟研究所碩士班
課程綱要.課程名稱(中文): 產業經濟學專題討論 （一）
課程綱要.課程目標: 透過學者與專家的演講，使學生深入了解產業經濟與財經法律領域中的最新學術研究與實務發展趨勢。
課程綱要.授課內容:
本課程旨在透過邀請產業經濟與財經法律領域之學者、實務專家與政府官員進行專題演講，協助學生掌握當前學術研究的前沿成果，並瞭解實務運作中的核心議題與挑戰。演講主題涵蓋但不限於下列方向：
1. 產業經濟趨勢與政策分析：
新興產業與數位轉型對市場結構的影響
公共政策如何影響產業發展（如競爭政策、補貼政策、永續政策）
2. 金融與資本市場法制發展：
加密資產、金融科技之法律監理動向
金融市場公平交易、內線交易與揭露義務
公司治理與投資人保護機制
3. 學術研究方法與實務應用：
如何從法律與經濟角度進行跨領域研究
實證研究在產經法制分析中的應用
個案研究與法規影響評估（Regulatory Impact Assessment）
4. 實務對話與職涯規劃
業界專家分享職涯經驗與跨域能力養成
政策制定者與學生之對談交流
鼓勵學生就演講主題進行提問、討論與寫作
本課程期望培養學生跨領域思維，提升其對實際產經與法制問題的理解力與批判能力，並鼓勵其進一步從事相關研究或進入相關職場領域。
課程綱要.評量配分比重: “1.出席10次的基本分數75分。少於10次者，每少一次扣2分。多於10次者，每多一次加2分。 2.每提問一次加5分。相同問題重複提問將不予計分(由主持老師判斷)。 3.同一位同學在同一場次最多提2個問題。 4.加分上限至95分為止。“
課程綱要.課程領域: 產業經濟 、 管制經濟與法律

課程綱要.開課單位: 產業經濟研究所碩士班
課程綱要.課程目標: 透過學者與專家的演講，使學生深入了解產業經濟與財經法律領域中的最新學術研究與實務發展趨勢。
課程綱要.授課內容:
本課程旨在透過邀請產業經濟與財經法律領域之學者、實務專家與政府官員進行專題演講，協助學生掌握當前學術研究的前沿成果，並瞭解實務運作中的核心議題與挑戰。演講主題涵蓋但不限於下列方向：
1. 產業經濟趨勢與政策分析：
新興產業與數位轉型對市場結構的影響
公共政策如何影響產業發展（如競爭政策、補貼政策、永續政策）
2. 金融與資本市場法制發展：
加密資產、金融科技之法律監理動向
金融市場公平交易、內線交易與揭露義務
公司治理與投資人保護機制
3. 學術研究方法與實務應用：
如何從法律與經濟角度進行跨領域研究
實證研究在產經法制分析中的應用
個案研究與法規影響評估（Regulatory Impact Assessment）
4. 實務對話與職涯規劃
業界專家分享職涯經驗與跨域能力養成
政策制定者與學生之對談交流
鼓勵學生就演講主題進行提問、討論與寫作
本課程期望培養學生跨領域思維，提升其對實際產經與法制問題的理解力與批判能力，並鼓勵其進一步從事相關研究或進入相關職場領域。
課程綱要.課程領域: 產業經濟 、 管制經濟與法律

課程綱要.開課單位: 產業經濟研究所碩士班
課程綱要.課程目標: Students are expected to gain a concrete understanding of the way industrial organizations operate and apply economic models to analyze competition, market power, regulation, and social welfare.
課程綱要.授課內容: A basic understanding of calculus and probability theory is expected.
課程綱要.教科書/參考書: Our lectures closely follow Paul Belleflamme and Martin Peitz (2015), Industrial Organization – Markets and Strategies, 2nd Edition, Cambridge, UK: Cambridge University Press (denoted "BP"). Please obtain a copyright version of this textbook, and supplementary learning materials, such as journal articles, will be disseminated in class. You may also consult the following textbook to better your understanding of industrial economics. On the more theoretical side, Jean Tirole (1988)'s The Theory of Industrial Organization, 1st Edition, published by the MIT Press would be a very good reference for model-builders. On the more intuitive side, Lynne Pepall, Dan Richards, George Norman (2014)'s Industrial Organization: Contemporary Theory and Empirical Applications, 5th Edition, published by John Wiley & Sons, Inc. would help you put the economic models in context. Other good references which I also recommend are Dennis W. Carlton and Jeffrey M. Perloff (2005)'s Modern Industrial Organization, Global Edition, 4th Edition, published by Pearson PLC, for you to derive insights from simplified models that I present in class. You may also read Luis M. B. Cabral (2000)'s Introduction to Industrial Organization, 2nd Edition, published by The MIT Press for you to frame your ideas from different perspectives.
課程綱要.評量配分比重: 30% Problem Sets, 20% Mid-term Exam, 20% Final Exam, 30% Term Project
課程綱要.彈性教學說明: Week 17 on oral presentation Week 18 for overall consultation

課程綱要.課程目標: Cloud Computing adopts the techniques of Big Data Analytics in order to do data manipulation. Since the conventional machine-learning algorithms can not fulfill the computing complexity due to dramatically increasing amounts of data, it is necessary to employ Deep Learning algorithms to process the big data for building the predictive models. Currently, for implementing the Deep Learning algorithms, the Python-based programming language — TensorFlow/Keras — is a de facto standard in industry. Hence, the objective of this course focuses on teaching students the TensorFlow/Keras programming language and Deep Learning algorithms, and, via the hands-on workshops, the students will learn how to build the predictive models as well as their applications.

課程綱要.課程目標: In recent years, the emerging technologies such as Generative AI, DeepSeek and Metaverse have surged, bringing disruptive breakthroughs and transformative innovations to both work and daily life. As this wave of technological development unfolds, legal issues related to these advancements—particularly in the realm of intellectual property—have become a focal point. Numerous lawsuits have already emerged internationally, especially in the US, while our country has positioned itself as an "AI Technology Island." Given this landscape, it is crucial for graduate students to strengthen their understanding of legal frameworks and case studies. Therefore, this course aims to equip students with the necessary legal knowledge and analytical skills to navigate this evolving field.

課程綱要.授課內容: 課程內容分為五大部分，第一部份基礎篇中，將介紹經濟最適化原則、市場的需求與供給。第二部分需求分析篇中，將強調消費者行為、需求估計與商業預測。第三部份生產與成本分析篇中，將分別介紹生產與成本分析與估算及線性規劃模式之應用。第四部分市場結構中，將介紹完成競爭、獨占、寡占市場結構與經營管理問題，並將探討市場定價與策略。第五部分為政府管制篇，授課重點為市場經濟中政府管制行為及其影響。
課程綱要.教科書/參考書: Economics for Managers, 14th ed. (作者: James R. McGuigan, Moyer, R. C. and Harris, F. H.，出版書局:華泰代理）

課程綱要.課程目標: 課程內容主要分為二大部分，第一部份授課的重點為結合產業經濟學的理論與計量或統計方法，建立分析產業結構與廠商行為的實証基礎。第二部分則為市場力量、研發創新、廣告、水平合併及垂直關係之理論與實證。
課程綱要.授課內容:
Professor Meng-Wen Tsou
Topics
1. Market Structure and Market Power & Structure-Conduct-Performance
2. New Empirical Industrial Organization
3. R＆D and Innovation
4 . Advertising
5. Horizontal Mergers and Vertical Relations
劉家樺老師：
Part I:
1. 經濟學重要概念
2. 需求分析
3. 需求的估計
Part II:
1. 生產理論與成本分析
2. 成本理論的應用
Part III:
1. 市場結構-1：競爭市場和獨占性競爭
2. 市場結構-2：獨占市場
3. 市場結構-3：寡占市場
4. 訂價方式與分析
Part IV:
分組報告實證文章：(1) 制度與成長；(2) 競爭與效率；(3)市場集中度與產業政策；(4) 價格理論
課程綱要.教科書/參考書: 隨堂講義。 教科書：Managerial Economics: Application, Strategy, and Tactics, by McGuigan, Moyer, Harris (管理經濟學，胡均立與邱俊榮編譯) Professor Meng-Wen Tsou 隨堂講義與實證文章，無教科書

課程綱要.課程名稱(英文): Seminar on the Civil Law and Business Law
課程綱要.課程目標: Course introduction: This course is designed to enable students to effectively grasp the current hot topics and future developments of civil law and commercial law in Taiwan. In addition, in commercial law, we will focus on the latest issues of company law, bankruptcy law, and securities regulations, so that students can truly understand the development trend of Taiwan‘s current commercial law.
課程綱要.授課內容:
Topics in this course include (but are not limited to) the following:
1. Civil law: typical and atypical contracts, properties and security interests, matrimonial regime, successional and legally reserved portions, etc.
2. Company law: directors‘ duty of care and duty of loyalty.
3. Bankruptcy Law: Voluntary and Involuntary Bankruptcy, Discharge, Rehabilitation, and Liquidation Procedures of the Consumer Debt Clearance Act.
4. Securities Regulations: Mergers and Acquisitions, Insider Trading.
課程綱要.教科書/參考書: The Modern Bankruptcy, Albert Yu-Wei Cheng, Angle Publish Co., 2022.
課程綱要.評量配分比重: Presentation and discussion 70％, Final Report 30％.
課程綱要.彈性教學說明: Self-directed learning has been deemed an important skill. It can increase students' self-confidence, independence, and motivation. Therefore, students can write a research paper in these two weeks.

課程綱要.課程名稱(英文): Key Legal Topics and Case Studies on Intellectual Property in Generative AI & the Metaverse
課程綱要.課程目標: In recent years, the emerging technologies such as Generative AI, DeepSeek and Metaverse have surged, bringing disruptive breakthroughs and transformative innovations to both work and daily life. As this wave of technological development unfolds, legal issues related to these advancements—particularly in the realm of intellectual property—have become a focal point. Numerous lawsuits have already emerged internationally, especially in the US, while our country has positioned itself as an "AI Technology Island." Given this landscape, it is crucial for graduate students to strengthen their understanding of legal frameworks and case studies. Therefore, this course aims to equip students with the necessary legal knowledge and analytical skills to navigate this evolving field.

1 ( / ) AI、生成式AI(ChatGPT/DeepSeek)、AI Agent技術導論
